text:
The process through the embassy is just to get clearance to enter the country together ( it is illegal to enter as a tourist with the intention to settle , your partner could get deported). 
After that you’ll have to start the visa process from within Israel. Or if you move first , you’ll have to apply online and wait for an appointment to hand in the paperwork physically. Just after that your partner will receive an invitation to enter. 

https://aic.org.il/the-gradual-process-birds-eye-view/
